definition: Distinct active employment spells on the day before period_start.
known_limitations: Employment spells require stable employee_id and hire_date.

definition: Distinct active employment spells on period_end.
known_limitations: Effective-dated organizational movement is not inferred.

definition: Period separations divided by the mean of opening and closing headcount.
known_limitations: Average headcount is an opening/closing approximation.

definition: Mature period hires separating within 60 days divided by mature period hires.
known_limitations: Latest hires are excluded until the full milestone window is observable.

definition: Sum of configured FTE for active closing employment spells.
known_limitations: Blank FTE defaults to 1.00; invalid values contribute zero.
